description: This Java class, WorkingDaysEnumerations, provides static methods to obtain enumeration options for different working days and repayment reschedule types, used within the Apache Fineract project to manage working day configurations and status types.

classes.name: WorkingDaysEnumerations
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to fetch enumeration data related to working days and repayment reschedule types.

methods.name: workingDaysStatusType
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData representing the status type of working days based on an integer ID.

methods.name: repaymentRescheduleType
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData object corresponding to a specified RepaymentRescheduleType, indicating various rescheduling options.
